values.title: “Preview environments per pull request changed how we review backend work.”
values.summary: 40 ms · median sync · 0 · dedicated infra hires
values.metadata: Marcus Lee · Staff Engineer at Loop & Co
values.body:
## The challenge

Loop & Co needed live cursors and shared editing, but did not want to build, run, and scale a socket layer of its own.

## Why Tessera

Query subscriptions and presence channels gave the team realtime without any new infrastructure. Every pull request also got its own preview environment to test against.

## Results

Median sync time is 40 ms, and the team shipped multiplayer editing without hiring anyone for infrastructure.
